[2m                        1. Add your recipesMy Recipes → Add New Recipe (or Paste / Import CSV). Each recipe holds ingredients, nutrition, cost, and fridge/freezer life.[22m

[2m                    [22m
[2m                        [22m

[2m                        1. Add your recipesMy Recipes → Add New Recipe (or Paste / Import CSV). Each recipe holds ingredients, nutrition, cost, and fridge/freezer life.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                                 [22m
[2m                        2. Plan your weekWeekly Planner → tap a meal slot on any day → pick a recipe. Use the “Add to” day chips to fill several days at once.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                          [22m
[2m                        3. Get your grocery listIt’s built automatically from your plan, grouped by category with totals. Check items off as you shop.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                        [22m
[2m                        4. Cook & mark “✓ Cooked”After cooking, tap ✓ Cooked on the recipe or planner. It deducts the ingredients from your pantry and saves the batch to your fridge.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                        [22m
[2m                        5. Track freshnessMy Fridge shows everything you’ve stored and how many days before it goes bad — with warnings when something’s about to expire.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                           [22m
[2m                        6. Pantry & pricesTrack what you already have and per-store prices in Ingredients, so “in stock” badges and costs stay accurate.[22m

[2m                Your weekly meal-prep loop, in 6 steps:[22m
[2m                [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                         [22m
[2m                        1. Add your recipesMy Recipes → Add New Recipe (or Paste / Import CSV). Each recipe holds ingredients, nutrition, cost, and fridge/freezer life.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                                 [22m
[2m                        2. Plan your weekWeekly Planner → tap a meal slot on any day → pick a recipe. Use the “Add to” day chips to fill several days at once.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                          [22m
[2m                        3. Get your grocery listIt’s built automatically from your plan, grouped by category with totals. Check items off as you shop.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                        [22m
[2m                        4. Cook & mark “✓ Cooked”After cooking, tap ✓ Cooked on the recipe or planner. It deducts the ingredients from your pantry and saves the batch to your fridge.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                        [22m
[2m                        5. Track freshnessMy Fridge shows everything you’ve stored and how many days before it goes bad — with warnings when something’s about to expire.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                           [22m
[2m                        6. Pantry & pricesTrack what you already have and per-store prices in Ingredients, so “in stock” badges and costs stay accurate.[22m

[2m                [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                         [22m
[2m                        1. Add your recipesMy Recipes → Add New Recipe (or Paste / Import CSV). Each recipe holds ingredients, nutrition, cost, and fridge/freezer life.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                                 [22m
[2m                        2. Plan your weekWeekly Planner → tap a meal slot on any day → pick a recipe. Use the “Add to” day chips to fill several days at once.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                          [22m
[2m                        3. Get your grocery listIt’s built automatically from your plan, grouped by category with totals. Check items off as you shop.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                        [22m
[2m                        4. Cook & mark “✓ Cooked”After cooking, tap ✓ Cooked on the recipe or planner. It deducts the ingredients from your pantry and saves the batch to your fridge.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                        [22m
[2m                        5. Track freshnessMy Fridge shows everything you’ve stored and how many days before it goes bad — with warnings when something’s about to expire.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                           [22m
[2m                        6. Pantry & pricesTrack what you already have and per-store prices in Ingredients, so “in stock” badges and costs stay accurate.[22m
[2m                    [22m
[2m                [22m
[2m                Also handy: in My Fridge, tap the 📖 on any item for storage tips, and Nutrition shows weekly totals vs your goals. Sign in to sync across your phone and PC.[22m
